Name: Dog Girl and Cat Girl Leah
Author: YukoValis
Description:
What good is a pony-girl without a dog-girl to run alongside?  Or how about a kitty girl to lay about on your farm? 
While not as useful, Leah is quite playful and happy here.

My next major project took longer then I wanted, but it sure as heck came out well.  At least I like to think so.  There is only so much you can get away with in pixels, and I'm a novice at best.   With that being said, I do hope you all enjoy this one.  It took about 16 hours to complete.

Cat girl now available.

---------:IMPORTANT NOTE:---------
Dog 1 and 2 were broken.  I think I fixed it now.
Seems the game has 3 versions of both cat and dog.  I added the three to 1.5
Content Patcher version seems to be ok.  Please let me know if these is any issue.
